author: David Niederhoffer
title: 'Nobody Wants This' Creator Erin Foster Reacts to Adam Brody's Comments Criticizing Israel - NewsBreak
text:
By David Niederhoffer ,
1 days ago Getty Adam Brody recently showed support for the “Free Palestine” movement and now Nobody Wants This creator Erin Foster is reacting to his comments.
If you don’t know, Adam portrays a Jewish Rabbi in the Netflix TV series, which just returned for a third season.
In a recent interview with GQ , Adam was asked if Hollywood has leaned more conservative in recent years. He was then given an opportunity to speak out about Israel and Palestine, to which he responded: “Put me down as thinking it’s a genocide. Put me down as wanting a free Palestine. It’s awful that it’s taken so much death and misery, but it does feel like it’s reaching a breaking point that it should have a while ago… I’m hopeful that another administration can really do some good and correct some of these policies that are helping that situation be as awful as it is.”
Erin is very vocal with her support for Israel and she’s speaking out on how she felt reading those comments.
Erin Foster responds to Adam Brody’s comments Erin spoke out in a new episode of the Not Skinny But Not Fat podcast, which will debut on October 27.
“You know, it’s complicated. I think our work environment, our set is very similar to dinner tables around the world where people are having debate and discussion and disagreeing,” Erin began. “And you know, while I love Adam, I also disagree with him. And that’s okay.”
“I think that as the creator of the show, all I can say is that I want our Jewish fans to know that I see you and I hear you and I understand how you feel. And the show has always been and always will be a love letter to Judaism,” Erin added. “That is why I made this show. It’s because of how beautiful of an experience I’ve had becoming Jewish and being a Jewish person, and sitting here right now at this time in the world where there is almost zero positive representation of Jewish people, I think it’s so important to have that and that is what this show is intended to be and so I want people to know that.”
“That being said, everyone is entitled to a different opinion than me,” she said. “I can just tell you what I created this show for, what the intention of the show is.”
Adam was already called out by someone else involved with the show.
